tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Application ground and the 1px gaps between regions.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Region panels: schema, inspector, bottom row, rail. Near-white, separated by hairlines rather than by tone.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Editable things: inputs, query editor, table body, a property in edit mode.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: The graph canvas: clean white (or near-black), so the label colours carry the picture. No permanent texture.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Canvas dot grid at `space-6` pitch, shown only while the view moves (pan, drag, zoom) as a motion cue.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairlines: region dividers, table row rules, section separators. 1px, never doubled.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs, segmented switches). Holds 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and node outlines on every surface and on canvas.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: counts, type names, timestamps, section labels. 4.5:1 on surface-000/100/200 and canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled glyphs and inactive tick marks only. Never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an `ink` fill (primary button, active segment, key cap pressed).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one brand hue (FF9036). Fills only: the RUN cap, the brand square, the busy LED. At most one signal fill per region. For thin marks use `signal-mark`; for text use `signal-ink`.

tokens.name: signal-mark
tokens.usage: Signal as a thin line or small mark that must hold 3:1: selection brackets, the expansion pulse, the minimap viewport, the current-row tick in lists and plans.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a `signal` fill. Ink on orange, both themes.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Signal colour when it must be read as text on surface-000/100/200 (a dirty field marker, 'UNCOMMITTED').

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Relationships and navigation: relationship type names, a selected edge, links to another entity. Text-safe on surface-100/200.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid outline, 1px offset. 3:1 on every surface including the canvas.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy / ONLINE / COMMITTED. Always paired with a word; never told apart from danger by hue alone.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: POPULATING, slow query, approaching limit. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: FAILED, constraint violation, rollback, destructive confirm. Always paired with a word and the ✕ mark.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Relationship lines on the canvas, 1.25px. Selected edges switch to `accent`.

tokens.name: node-line
tokens.usage: Outline of every node shape and label swatch, 1.5px. Ink on paper; in the dark theme the canvas colour, so bright nodes read as cut-out stickers.

tokens.name: lb-1
tokens.usage: Label colour 1 (yellow, FFEC5D). Node fill on canvas, swatch in the schema. Outline is `node-line`.

tokens.name: lb-2
tokens.usage: Label colour 2 (green, 27D37D).

tokens.name: lb-3
tokens.usage: Label colour 3 (sky, 55C1DC).

tokens.name: lb-4
tokens.usage: Label colour 4 (coral, FF7277).

tokens.name: lb-5
tokens.usage: Label colour 5 (peach). A softer companion to the five brand hues; for a sixth coloured label.

tokens.name: lb-6
tokens.usage: Label colour 6 (stone). Neutral: documents, records, and labels not yet assigned a colour.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and the cover only. Never in working UI.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Inspector header, dialog titles. One per region.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, navigator rows, menu items.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Selected row, label names in the navigator.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section headers, button captions, rail captions. Always uppercase. The Braun/TE engraving voice.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, node captions on canvas, tooltips.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Queries, property values, IDs, table cells holding values.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Counts in the navigator, status rail values, log timestamps.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: A single headline figure inside the storage or plan panel. Tabular digits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-text gap, cell inner padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding, gap between controls in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Region inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a region; inspector section spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Canvas grid pitch; separation between top-level groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state margins. Rarely needed elsewhere.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Regions, tables, inputs. The default.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, key caps. Machined, not soft.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status LEDs and circular nodes only. Organic curves belong to the three Colani controls and live in their SVG geometry, not here.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Exactly one shadow, for things that float above the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Radial menu, navigation puck, command palette. Nothing docked ever casts a shadow.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Navigator, table, property and log rows.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented switches.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Status/instrument rail height.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every divider and control border.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Schema navigator default width (resizable 200–360).

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: Inspector default width (resizable 260–420).

timing.note: Durations and curves. Most interactions sit between 80 and 250 ms. No bounce, no overshoot.

tokens.name: t-instant
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggle, segment slide.

tokens.name: t-quick
tokens.usage: Glyph micro-animations, row reveal, menu open.

tokens.name: t-move
tokens.usage: Edges drawing outward, panel content swap, table↔graph.

tokens.name: t-settle
tokens.usage: Damped layout adjustment after expansion. The ceiling for any single motion.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for everything that arrives.

tokens.name: ease-damped
tokens.usage: Layout settle: fast start, critically damped stop, never overshoots.
